notes.title: Fixed screen transition bug, Supports multiple monitors
notes.content:
hi.

1. The issue of screen switching not working properly has been fixed. 
2. When there are multiple monitors, you can change the position of the game screen.
(Move the game window with the mouse and press Adapt Screen in the options.)

thanks you.

notes.title: New Start - Easy mode added, you can enjoy the game more easily
notes.content:
1. New Start - Easy has been added
This is a mode where the damage given by monsters is greatly reduced.
You can play the game a little easier.
There is no change from the existing save, and you must start over.

2. When playing the game, CPU usage has been slightly reduced (optimization).
3. When running the game, the engine intro will skip over quickly if you press the 'esc' key.
4. Fixed an issue where monsters would not hit you when attacking from close range
5. The inconvenience of the first battle with the White Fox has been slightly improved.

Thank you :)
